reports.title: Glaukos Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

lines: Raised 2026 net sales guidance to $775 million to $785 million, compared to $680 million to $700 million previously.
Introduced preliminary 2027 net sales guidance of $1 billion.
The company expects 2026 net sales to be in the range of $775 million to $785 million based on the latest foreign currency exchange rates.
The company expects preliminary 2027 net sales to be $1 billion based on the latest foreign currency exchange rates.
Glaukos now expects full-year 2026 global consolidated net sales of $775 - $785 million, up from its previous guidance of $680 - $700 million.
